raw.query: SELECT p.run_id, p.window_name, p.sla_metric, p.p99_ms, p.n_requests, p.is_current, d.superseded_by, d.source_path FROM provenance.v_pool_latency AS p JOIN provenance.v_dim AS d USING (run_id) WHERE p.run_id IN ('aggregate44:fc_p90_L30', 'aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_ds4') AND p.is_current = true AND d.is_current = true ORDER BY p.run_id
raw.observed: Baseline encoder_delay p99=588.37 ms; ds4 encoder_delay p99=1403.774 ms; both have n_requests=749601, window_name=NULL, is_current=true, superseded_by=NULL.
raw.claimed: ~1.6 MB/image; DeepStack 4x payload on 25 Gbps; handoff p99 272->1,087 ms; encoder-delay p99 1,404 ms; SLA violation from transfer alone.
raw.evidence: v_pool_latency supports the rounded 1,404 ms ds4 encoder-delay result, but exposes no payload size, DeepStack multiplier, link rate, handoff percentile, SLA flag, per-window breakdown, or transfer-alone causal attribution.
raw.fix: State only that the aggregate ds4 sensitivity raises encoder-delay p99 from 588.37 to 1403.774 ms over 749601 requests; remove the payload, 25 Gbps, 272->1,087 ms handoff, SLA, and transfer-alone assertions unless separately provenance-backed.
